item.title: International Women's Day screening planned for documentary
item.description: A documentary that highlights the contributions of local women to the community is set for a March 8 screening at the Kiwanis Theatre. Coinciding with International Women’s Day, there are a number of events planned, including an 11 a.m. downtown march, starting at the Chatham-Kent Civic Centre, with the free screening of This Women’s Work […]

item.title: Driver airlifted after Walpole crash
item.description: A driver was airlifted to hospital with critical injuries after a Saturday morning crash on Walpole Island First Nation, police said. The single-vehicle crash happened on Chiefs Road, just before 6 a.m., police said. A 37-year-old Walpole man was taken to Chatham-Kent Health Alliance, then later airlifted to Victoria Hospital in London, OPP said Sunday […]
